module.name: aws_eks_cluster_jumphost
module.description: Provisions a single bastion EC2 instance (jumphost) in a public subnet for an EKS cluster whose public API endpoint is CIDR-locked. Generates an RSA-4096 key pair, attaches an IAM role with AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore + eks:DescribeCluster, assigns an Elastic IP, and bootstraps kubectl via aws eks update-kubeconfig at first boot. SSH inbound is locked to the operator source IP (/32). SSM Session Manager is available as a fallback.

required.reason: Provides eks_cluster_name, vpc_id, and public_subnet_ids for an existing cluster.

optional.reason: Greenfield upstream — emits the same vpc_id / public_subnet_ids / cluster_name output shape so this module works identically for new clusters.

required.name: aws_access_key_id
required.description: AWS access key ID. Resolved by Forge's credential template at deploy time (any auth method).

required.name: eks_cluster_name
required.description: Name of the EKS cluster the jumphost is provisioned for.

required.name: vpc_id
required.description: VPC ID where the jumphost security group and instance are placed.

required.name: public_subnet_ids
required.description: Public subnet IDs. The jumphost is placed in the first subnet (index 0).

required.name: user_ip
required.description: Operator source IP in CIDR /32 notation (e.g. 203.0.113.1/32). Locks SSH inbound to this address only.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS session token. Populated for STS / SSO / assumed-role; empty for static keys.

optional.name: jumphost_instance_type
optional.description: EC2 instance type for the jumphost. t3.medium is sufficient for kubectl + aws CLI usage.

optional.name: jumphost_volume_size
optional.description: Root EBS volume size in GiB (8–100).

optional.name: kubectl_version
optional.description: kubectl version to install (e.g. 1.32.0). Should match the cluster's Kubernetes minor version.

optional.name: tags
optional.description: Additional tags applied to all created resources.

key_outputs.name: jumphost_public_ip
key_outputs.description: Elastic IP address of the jumphost.

key_outputs.name: jumphost_private_key_pem
key_outputs.description: RSA private key PEM. Retrieve once and store securely.

key_outputs.name: jumphost_instance_id
key_outputs.description: EC2 instance ID of the jumphost.

key_outputs.name: jumphost_security_group_id
key_outputs.description: Security group ID attached to the jumphost.

optional.name: aws_session_token
optional.description: AWS credential template (STS / SSO / assumed-role only).
